item: Airplane mode refuses a request on a keep-alive connection opened before the Stop
summary: R638, from an independent read of R636 (probe_pooled.py, 2026-11-09): the socket guard met a connection only at resolve, connect, tunnel and (R619) an absolute-form request line, so a pooled keep-alive connection opened while the switch was clear kept sending after a Stop; with loopback treated as remote, a requests.Session answered 200, then 200 with the switch engaged, and was refused only on a new connection. src/ingest/airplane.py's putrequest patch now also refuses, while airplane mode is engaged, a request on a connection whose OWN destination is not local: self.host, classified as the connect guard classifies a connect; only an OPEN connection is classified (a fresh one is left to the connect guard, unchanged words); it must have a loopback socket PEER as well as a loopback host name (security read A: urllib3 reports localhost. as localhost); any tunnelling connection (_tunnel_host), urllib3 SOCKS connection (_socks_options, because under TLS the SSLSocket drops PySocks' proxy attribute: both security reads) or PySocks socket with a proxy set counts as not local whatever name it carries; an unreadable host or peer fails closed. Fixed words, never the host (R142). The switch is read where the request is written, so a Stop that lands after a caller's own check is met; the online path costs one flag read and one Event.is_set. activate_kill_switch() now also closes the pooled connections of every EthicalFetcher session and every GuardedSession (a WeakSet under an RLock, registered in their constructors), after the switch is set and never raising; a closed session reopens pools on its next request. Tests (tests/test_airplane_keepalive.py): a connection opened before Stop sends zero further bytes after it; a Stop between the caller's switch read and the send (and inside requests' adapter send) is refused; a tunnelled connection is refused for example.com, localhost and 127.0.0.1; local destinations (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1) still work; requests, urllib.request and http.client end to end; the fetcher's pools empty on Stop and the session works after the switch clears; a removed check lets the request out; urllib3's HTTP/2 connection (which bypasses putrequest) is not injected. docs/SECURITY.md states the residual against the 16-library socket-importer allowlist (imaplib/poplib mailbox pull already connected finishes its pull; httpx loopback LLM clients; native code) and why patching socket send (option b) was declined. Release-notes line: with airplane mode on, a connection the app opened before you went offline can no longer be used to send anything, and the app closes its idle connections the moment you go offline.
